live -69 shape minute 1/8 + daily 1/800 PASSes and D1 runs (5 data calls); the 10-attempt day budget is charged to the daily allowance, never to plan_limit=8

pinned limiter refuses the 9th credit inside the rolling minute and any credit past 800/day BEFORE further transport; a saturated minute bucket alone does not refuse the preflight (spacing is the limiter's job, pacing is not a budget refusal)
daily 795 + required 10 > 800 -> HOLD before data, and the REFUSE outcome receipt is persisted (the -69 refusal left no body; this one leaves both files)
the exact -69 live body (minute pair only) HOLDs at USAGE_DAILY_SCHEMA — daily schema unestablishable, no headroom invented — and the refusal body is persisted for audit this time
string/float/bool/negative daily fields and missing/negative/string minute fields -> USAGE_DAILY_SCHEMA / USAGE_SCHEMA refusals, each carrying its REFUSE outcome receipt
half-present daily pairs, daily_usage > limit, and any plan_daily_limit != pinned 800 (400 or 10000) -> HOLD; no daily allowance but the pinned Basic 800/day is ever honored
plan_limit=100000 with no daily pair still HOLDs — minute fields never satisfy the daily gate (under the -68 reading this body passed any headroom)
REFUSE and PASS receipts both persist exact body bytes hash-matching the receipt (count + SHA-256); a recorded refusal is sticky — a later session returns it with zero re-calls
body-write failure (path is a directory) -> USAGE_RECEIPT_PERSIST_FAILED before any data fetch; a PASS that cannot be evidenced is not a PASS
429 then 200 -> PASS at attempt 2, statuses [429, 200] accounted in the receipt; 429 x2 -> USAGE_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED with a REFUSE receipt; never a third attempt

flipped body bytes, altered params / execution date / manifest pin, edited payload, and a session bound to another store marker all refuse before any transport (USAGE_RECEIPT_BODY_MISMATCH; USAGE_CACHE_PARAMS; USAGE_CACHE_DATE; USAGE_CACHE_BINDING; USAGE_CACHE_BODY_ALTERED)

three frozen-semantics paths proven: gate refusal totals exactly 1 call (0 data); first-leg RETRIES_EXHAUSTED totals 1 usage + 2 data = 3 with an immediate stop; worst-case successful Day 1 totals 1 usage + 10 data = 11 <= the 12 hard ceiling; clean days total 6 (U01/Q07)

api-credits-left=100000 cannot waive a failed daily gate (gate refuses first); used != current_usage and used+left != plan_limit both refuse USAGE_HEADER_MISMATCH — headers reconcile or refuse, they never authorize

every write truncated to 1 byte: the write-all loop still completes the transaction; exact body bytes land, hash/count match the receipt, no temp litter, and the committed PASS reopens with zero re-calls
os.write returning 0 is a refusal, never a spin: USAGE_RECEIPT_PERSIST_FAILED, no final body/receipt, no temp litter
first write (body staging) raises -> USAGE_RECEIPT_PERSIST_FAILED before data transport; nothing published, temps cleaned
fsync #1 (body file) raises -> HOLD before data; the unfsynced body is never published
receipt staging write raises -> HOLD; publishing happens only after BOTH artifacts are staged, so the staged body temp is cleaned and nothing is visible
fsync #2 (receipt file) raises -> HOLD before data; nothing published, temps cleaned
publish (hard-link) raises -> HOLD before data; no final body/receipt, temps cleaned
parent-dir fsync after body publish raises -> HOLD; receipt never committed; the orphaned body makes any later persist refuse (collision) with its bytes untouched
a pre-existing orphan body refuses the persist (USAGE_PERSIST_COLLISION) and its bytes are never silently overwritten
a committed receipt whose body evidence is absent proves nothing: USAGE_RECEIPT_BODY_MISSING before any transport (zero usage calls)
committed PASS and REFUSE both survive reopen: byte count / SHA-256 / manifest / store / day bindings reverify, reuse costs zero calls, and neither artifact carries credential material

fsync #4 (parent dir after receipt publication) fails -> the invocation HOLDs (USAGE_RECEIPT_PERSIST_FAILED) with zero data transport; the published receipt stays PENDING (commit_state 0, verdict PASS, body binding intact) and a later session refuses it as USAGE_COMMIT_UNCERTAIN with zero calls — never a silent PASS, and no cleanup was needed or tried

fsync #4 fails with every post-failure write unavailable (the -72 double-failure branch): the invocation HOLDs, zero data; the receipt was never anything but PENDING, so a later session HOLDs as USAGE_COMMIT_UNCERTAIN with zero transport — no cleanup exists that could have failed

the monotonic activation write raises -> the write-all loop propagates (nothing swallowed), the invocation HOLDs USAGE_RECEIPT_PERSIST_FAILED, the commit byte on disk stays 0, and reopen HOLDs as USAGE_COMMIT_UNCERTAIN with zero calls

the activation write returns 0 (zero progress) -> the write-all loop refuses it as a short write, the invocation HOLDs, the commit byte stays 0, and reopen HOLDs as USAGE_COMMIT_UNCERTAIN with zero calls — never a spin, never a silent PASS

a stored PASS whose commit_state is missing, still 0 (pending), a word, an integer, or a two-character string refuses as USAGE_COMMIT_UNCERTAIN before any transport — only the exact committed byte 1 is interpretable

exact commit layout on real PASS and REFUSE receipts: marker/prefix occur exactly once; the value-prefix offset (index + 17) names the '0' byte; activation changes exactly that one byte and no other; the activated receipt parses with commit_state == '1'
duplicated commit marker in the staged receipt -> structured USAGE_RECEIPT_PERSIST_FAILED / USAGE_COMMIT_LAYOUT_INVALID before staging; no finals published, no reusable receipt, no AssertionError
L01/L02 pass identically under python -O (asserts stripped): layout validation is explicit runtime logic, not assert-dependent
